summary: Organigram Global Inc. filed a Form 6-K attaching a press release dated August 4, 2026, announcing plans to report third-quarter fiscal 2026 financial results on August 11, 2026, before market open, followed by a conference call. The release includes logistics and background on the company's operations and cannabis brands. This is a routine earnings-date notification with no special-situation elements such as mergers, tender offers, restructuring, or activist activity.
